rationale: Kshitij brings deep expertise in hardware verification and protocol testing (SystemVerilog, UVM, AXI) from semiconductor IP work at Nvidia and Synopsys, while Parth is actively testing and validating complex mechanical and electrical systems on Tesla's humanoid robot program. Their skill sets are highly complementary for a hardware-focused hackathon project—Kshitij's verification rigor and testing frameworks could directly strengthen Parth's hands-on hardware validation approach, and Parth's real-world robotics testing experience could ground Kshitij's protocol expertise in cutting-edge applications.
intro_message: Kshitij Gupta, meet Parth Behani — you're both deep in hardware testing and validation (chip verification vs. robotics systems), and could be a strong pairing if you're both building something hardware-forward at the hackathon.
